listing.name: Quake 4 (openQ4)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Upstream runtime package for openQ4; use own game files per documented setup, with upstream/player owning installation and runtime replacement. Observed release artifacts are evidence, not operational package selection or Portcove support. Limits: Upstream only: Beta with legitimate PC Quake4 data. Package/platform labels do not establish physical hardware or gameplay qualification. Beta Windows/Linux x64/ARM64 and experimental macOS; WindowsARM64 built but no hardware confirmation. Packages do not establish GPL engine vs game SDK licensing authority; keep notices. Upstream platforms: Windows/Linux x64/ARM64; experimental macOS. Windows ARM64 built but not confirmed on hardware; Linux ARM64 preview. Original data: Quake4 legitimate installed game and matching data. Exact source revision/hash and BIOS/firmware requirements not stated above remain Unknown in this review. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
